            Given the doctor has a list of appointments
            And there is at least one pending appointment
            When the doctor views the appointments list
            Then the pending appointment is displayed

          Scenario: Provide consultation and generate prescription
            Given the doctor has a pending appointment
            When the doctor provides consultation for the appointment
            Then the consultation is provided
            And a prescription is generated

          Scenario Outline: Prescribe lab tests
            Given the doctor has a pending appointment
            When the doctor prescribes <number> lab tests
            Then the lab tests are prescribed
            And the system generates a request for the lab

            Examples:
              | number |
              | 1      |
              | 0      |
              | -1     |

          Scenario: Request lab test
            Given the doctor has prescribed at least one lab test
            When the system requests the lab test
            Then the lab test is created and requested to the lab

          Scenario: Prescribe medicines
            Given the doctor has a pending appointment
            When the doctor prescribes one medicine
            Then the medicine is prescribed

          Scenario: Request medicine delivery
            Given the doctor has prescribed at least one medicine
            When the system requests the medicine delivery
            Then the medicine is requested to the chemist for delivery

          Scenario: Update lab report
            Given the lab test has been performed
            When the lab report is updated
            Then the report for the patient is updated (offline)

          Scenario: Release lab report
            Given the lab report is updated
            When the lab report is released
            Then the patient can view the lab report (offline)
